I am on sabbatical for the Fall 2026 and Spring 2027 semesters. During this time, I am gaining industry experience as Principal Scientist at [Fluid Concepts Research](https://fluidconcepts.ai).

I will not be recruiting new graduate students during this admissions cycle. If you are thinking about applying to work with me in a future cycle, please watch this page for announcements.
